title: Break the glass: only a registration number
description: The open padlock: Dr Hafiz has only Kamal's registration number, and the facility reaches his summary through it.

blocks.detail: Kamal is unconscious and cannot show his code; Salmah is not with him. His summary is reached by registration number, because he opted in on his wallet.

blocks.title: Break the glass
blocks.text: Opened without the code or the passcode. The access is logged and reported to Malaysia.

buttons.label: Give the number to the facility

try: Ask the room who may break the glass, and who is told afterwards
